meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for Indonesia merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: BPS – Statistics Indonesia (Badan Pusat Statistik)
reports.description: The national statistical office of Indonesia. Responsible for censuses, surveys, and the large majority of official socio-economic statistics. Publishes an extensive catalogue of recurring series and the annual Statistical Yearbook of Indonesia.
reports._notes: Institutional core node. Every subsequent BPS series will reference this authority.
_referenced_by: All major BPS statistical programmes and the Statistical Yearbook
National planning documents (RPJMN) and policy analysis that cite official data
reports._cadence_evidence: bps.go.id is the agency's live dissemination portal (Berita Resmi Statistik, Tabel Statistik, Publikasi, Rencana Terbit); it carries series from monthly press releases to decennial censuses, so the site itself has no single release cadence.

reports.title: Statistical Yearbook of Indonesia (Statistik Indonesia)
reports.description: Flagship annual compendium presenting geographic, demographic, social and economic statistics drawn from BPS and other agencies. Provides national and provincial comparisons and technical notes. Continuously cited as the single-volume overview of official Indonesian statistics.
reports._notes: Highest-visibility recurring BPS product. Functions as the ‘one-stop’ official statistical reference.
_referenced_by: Policy documents, academic work and international reports that need a comprehensive official snapshot
Provincial statistical yearbooks that mirror its structure

reports.title: Population Census (Sensus Penduduk) and Long Form results
reports.description: Decennial population census (most recent full cycle SP2020 with short-form enumeration and subsequent Long Form survey). Produces the definitive population stock, fertility, mortality, migration and related demographic parameters used throughout the statistical system.
reports._notes: Foundational demographic node. The Long Form SP2020 results are the current high-detail source for fertility, mortality and migration.
_referenced_by: Labour-force, education, health and poverty surveys that use census frames
National Medium-Term Development Plan (RPJMN) population targets
reports._cadence_evidence: sensus.bps.go.id serves census tabulations for SP2010 and SP2020 - census rounds ten years apart; the SP2010 topic page metadata says 'Frekuensi update: Lebih dari Dua Tahunan'.

reports.title: National Accounts / GDP statistics (PDB)
reports.description: Quarterly and annual national accounts (Produk Domestik Bruto) by expenditure and by industrial origin, at current and constant prices. Provincial GDP (PDRB) series exist and will be densified later.
reports._notes: Core macro node. Provincial PDRB will form the main spatial economic layer in later batches.
_referenced_by: Bank Indonesia Economic Report on Indonesia
reports._cadence_evidence: BPS press releases 'Ekonomi Indonesia Triwulan ...' appear once per quarter (Tw III-2023 06 Nov 2023, Tw IV-2023 05 Feb 2024, Tw III-2025 05 Nov 2025, Tw I-2026 05 May 2026). The compendium 'Produk Domestik Bruto Indonesia Triwulanan 2021-2025' page itself states frequency 'Annually'.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index (Indeks Harga Konsumen – IHK)
reports.description: Monthly Consumer Price Index and inflation rates. Compiled for a set of cities and aggregated to national urban inflation. Primary inflation indicator used by Bank Indonesia and the government.
reports._notes: High-frequency price node. Directly linked to monetary policy and poverty measurement.
_referenced_by: Bank Indonesia monetary-policy decisions and reports
Poverty line calculations and real-income analysis

reports.title: National Labour Force Survey (Sakernas)
reports.description: Periodic labour-force survey producing employment, unemployment, underemployment, labour-force participation and informal-sector indicators. Principal official source for labour-market statistics.
reports._cadence_original: multiple rounds per year (frequency has varied; currently high-frequency)
reports._notes: Core labour node. Critical for understanding the large informal sector and youth employment challenges.
_referenced_by: Bank Indonesia and fiscal assessments of the real economy
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Keadaan Angkatan Kerja di Indonesia Agustus 2025' (released 19 Dec 2025) states Periodisasi: 'Semesteran'; the February round is published separately (Februari 2025 edition released 20 Jun 2025).

reports.title: Poverty statistics (official poverty line and incidence)
reports.description: Official poverty measurement using the basic-needs poverty line (food + non-food). Published at national and provincial level, with urban/rural splits. Continuously cited in RPJMN targets and social-protection design.
reports._notes: High-policy-visibility social node. Provincial poverty rates will be important for later regional densification.
reports._cadence_evidence: BPS issues 'Profil Kemiskinan di Indonesia' for the March and September Susenas rounds each year (Maret 2025 release; September 2025 release dated 05 Feb 2026). The book 'Computation and Analysis of Macro Poverty' is separately listed as 'Annually'.

reports.title: National Socio-Economic Survey (Susenas)
reports.description: Large-scale household survey that is the primary source for consumption, expenditure, poverty calculation, education, health and many SDG indicators. Conducted in multiple modules and rounds.
reports._notes: Foundational household microdata node that underpins poverty, inequality and many social statistics.
reports._cadence_evidence: Susenas is fielded twice a year: BPS office notices for 'Susenas Maret' (2019, 2020, 2021, 2024) and 'Susenas September' (2018, 2025); these two rounds feed the two annual poverty releases.

reports.title: Bank Indonesia – central bank statistical and policy publications
reports.description: Central bank of Indonesia. Publishes monetary statistics, balance of payments, financial-system statistics (SSKI), the Economic Report on Indonesia (LPI), Financial Stability Review, and multiple surveys (business, banking, property).
reports._notes: Second institutional pillar alongside BPS. Will generate multiple detailed series in subsequent batches.
reports._cadence_evidence: bi.go.id hosts continuously updated statistics alongside a mixed portfolio (SEKI monthly, LKM and NPI quarterly, KSK semi-annual, LPI annual) - the publications landing page lists ~16 series with different frequencies, so there is no single cadence for the node.

reports.title: Economic Report on Indonesia (Laporan Perekonomian Indonesia – LPI)
reports.description: Bank Indonesia’s flagship annual economic report. Reviews domestic and external performance, monetary and financial developments, and policy outlook. Continuously cited as the authoritative central-bank narrative.
reports._notes: High-authority annual narrative node from the central bank.
_referenced_by: International assessments of the Indonesian economy

reports.title: Indonesia Financial System Statistics (SSKI)
reports.description: Monthly compilation of financial-system indicators covering banks, non-bank financial institutions, financial markets, payment systems, and related real-sector linkages. Core macroprudential data product.
reports._notes: High-frequency financial-system node.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and International Investment Position
reports.description: Standard BPM-based balance-of-payments and IIP statistics. Key external-sector series for a commodity-exporting and capital-flow-sensitive economy.
reports._notes: Core external-sector node.
reports._cadence_evidence: Bank Indonesia issues 'Neraca Pembayaran Indonesia' once per quarter - separate report pages for Triwulan III 2023, Triwulan I 2024, Triwulan IV 2025 and Triwulan I 2026.

reports.title: Inter-provincial / inter-regional trade statistics (Perdagangan Antar Wilayah)
reports.description: Official BPS publication on inter-provincial trade — purchases and sales of goods between provinces, trade maps, and modes of transport. Captures the domestic commercial circulation that links Java, Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Papua and the other islands.
reports._notes: Core domestic-commerce node. Shows that Indonesia is not only an international transit state but also a complex internal trading system across thousands of islands.
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Perdagangan Antar Wilayah Indonesia 2024' publication page states Periodisasi 'Tahunan' (annual), released 31 Dec 2025, ISSN 2745-6706.

reports.title: Inter-island trade volume and value (selected commodity series)
reports.description: Statistics on inter-island movements of food crops and other commodities. Complements the broader inter-provincial trade publication with commodity-specific domestic flow data.
reports._notes: Commodity-flow densification of the domestic-trade cluster.
reports._url_evidence: BPS page confirms 'Perdagangan Antar Wilayah Indonesia 2024', on inter-provincial purchases and sales with trade maps and transport modes.
reports._cadence_evidence: Same publication as cited: 'Perdagangan Antar Wilayah Indonesia 2024', Periodisasi 'Tahunan', released 31 Dec 2025.

reports.title: Special Economic Zones (KEK) statistics and regulatory framework
reports.publisher: Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs / KEK administration / related
reports.description: Regulatory framework and performance statistics for Indonesia’s Special Economic Zones (Kawasan Ekonomi Khusus). Includes tax holidays, customs facilities, VAT treatment and investment incentives designed to attract industry to designated locations across the archipelago.
reports._notes: Policy instrument that explicitly tries to shape industrial location across a diverse archipelago.
reports._cadence_evidence: kek.go.id returned no readable body content on two fetches (/ and /id); no frequency statement and no countable dated report series could be read from the site.

reports.title: Free Trade and Free Port Zones (KPBPB / FTZ) — Batam, Bintan, Karimun, Sabang
reports.publisher: Directorate General of Customs / related legal framework
reports.description: Free Trade and Free Port Zones with separate customs treatment (duty, VAT, excise relief). Batam–Bintan–Karimun form the principal FTZ complex facing Singapore and the Malacca approaches; Sabang is the western outlier. Legal basis in successive laws and implementing regulations.
reports._notes: Customs-and-tariff regime node that sits directly on the approaches to the Malacca Strait.
_referenced_by: Malacca Strait and Riau Islands regional analysis
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved the DJBC (Directorate General of Customs and Excise) regulation directory topic page 'Kawasan Perdagangan Bebas', which lists 14 instruments governing free trade and free port zones from UU 36/2000 (the founding law) through PMK-34/PMK.04/2021 and PMK-173/PMK.03/2021 on goods entry/exit and VAT treatment, up to PER-4/BC/2026. This is the customs legal framework for the KPBPB/FTZ regime. The DJBC content page beacukai.go.id/arsip/fas/fasilitas-kawasan-khusus.html still returns a 404 shell and bpbatam.go.id is still 403.
reports._url_route: alternate hostname on the same publisher - peraturan.beacukai.go.id serves static content where www.beacukai.go.id content paths 404
reports._cadence_evidence: The cited Bea Cukai page is a directory of legal instruments for free-trade zones - UU No. 36/2000, PMK 34/PMK.04/2021, PMK 173/PMK.03/2021, Perdirjen 4/BC/2026 etc. These are regulations, not a recurring publication.

reports.title: Customs, tariff and trade-facilitation regime
reports.publisher: Directorate General of Customs and Excise / Ministry of Finance / Ministry of Trade
reports.description: The broader customs and tariff framework that governs both international and (indirectly) domestic trade. Includes preferential treatment under ASEAN, RCEP and bilateral arrangements, as well as the special regimes applied inside SEZs and FTZs.
reports._notes: Umbrella regulatory node for tariff and border treatment.
reports._url_evidence: Directorate General of Customs and Excise reference page confirmed to carry the Buku Tarif Kepabeanan Indonesia (BTKI) 2022 and customs tariff/exchange-rate references.
reports._cadence_evidence: BTKI is reissued with each Harmonized System revision: BTKI 2012, BTKI 2017 and BTKI 2022 (effective 1 April 2022, per Bea Cukai's 'Ketentuan Buku Tarif Kepabeanan Indonesia (BTKI) 2022' FAQ) - about one edition every five years. Note the cited /referensi/btki-dan-tarif URL now returns 404; the tariff book itself is enacted by PMK.

reports.title: Defence budget and military expenditure statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Defence / Ministry of Finance / international compilations citing official figures
reports.description: Official and widely cited defence budget allocations (recent figures rising toward Rp 187 trillion in 2026) and broader military-expenditure estimates. Defence burden remains relatively low as a share of GDP for an archipelagic state with extensive maritime interests.
reports._notes: Core defence-resource node. Links fiscal capacity to the maritime-strategic layer.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved the Ministry of Finance publication 'Informasi APBN Tahun Anggaran 2025'. It contains the table '10 Kementerian/Lembaga dengan Pagu Terbesar pada APBN 2025' in which Kementerian Pertahanan appears fifth with Rp166.26 trillion. Also verified as a secondary route that the Ministry of Defence PPID does publish budget documents at https://ppid.kemhan.go.id/web/ppid/informasi-berkala (RKA 2021/2023/2024/2025, DIPA 2022/2023/2025, audited Laporan Keuangan 2020/2022/2024) - contrary to the earlier finding that it listed none.
reports._url_route: static asset host media.kemenkeu.go.id, bypassing the JS-only www.kemenkeu.go.id shell; kemhan PPID confirmed as a working backup
reports._cadence_evidence: The cited PDF is 'Informasi APBN 2025' from the Directorate General of Budget - one booklet per fiscal year; the text refers to improving 'penyusunan Buku Informasi APBN selanjutnya' (the next year's edition).

reports.title: Defence and security policy framing (archipelagic posture)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Defence / related strategic documents
reports.description: Recurring policy and strategic framing of Indonesia’s defence posture as an archipelagic state, including modernisation programmes and the linkage between territorial integrity, sea lanes and external security.
reports._notes: Policy-frame node that connects the defence cluster to the strategic-geography layer.
reports._url_evidence: PDF on the Ministry of Defence domain confirmed as Buku Putih Pertahanan Indonesia (Defence White Paper), setting out archipelagic defence doctrine and strategy.
reports._cadence_evidence: The cited document is the Buku Putih Pertahanan Indonesia 2008 (18 Feb 2008), which states it updates the 2003 white paper 'Mempertahankan Tanah Air Memasuki Abad XXI' - two editions five years apart, i.e. roughly one per five years.

reports.title: Statistics of Education
reports.description: Annual BPS education statistics covering process and outcome indicators from Susenas and administrative school data (schools, classrooms, teachers, sanitation). National and provincial presentation.

_variants.description: Official statistics on school enrolment, educational attainment, literacy and related indicators, largely drawn from Susenas and administrative sources.
_variants.notes: Human-capital node linked to the large youth population and skills agenda.
_variants.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia / Ministry of Education related
_variants.title: Education statistics (enrolment, attainment, literacy)

reports._notes: Core education statistical product.
_referenced_by: Welfare Indicators and RPJMN human-development targets
reports._variants_reviewed: 2026-08-18: reviewed, no change. The kept record was the better of the two — differences were a vaguer title, a publisher abbreviation, a less specific URL, or an identical value.

reports.title: Gross Enrolment Ratio in tertiary education by province
reports.description: Provincial GER for tertiary education (age 19–23). Shows extreme variation — Yogyakarta far above the national average, eastern provinces much lower — reinforcing the spatial human-capital gradient.
reports._notes: High-visibility spatial education node (Yogyakarta outlier is especially notable).
reports._cadence_evidence: Tertiary GER is published in BPS 'Statistik Pendidikan' (Susenas-based), one edition per year: 2023 (24 Nov 2023), 2024 (22 Nov 2024), 2025 (21 Nov 2025).

reports.title: Construction in Figures / construction sector statistics
reports.description: Annual compilation of construction-sector data: workers, wages, construction value, materials, indices, construction GRDP, Construction Cost Index, etc. Provincial tables included.
reports._notes: Infrastructure and fixed-investment densification node.

reports.title: Paddy and rice production statistics by province
reports.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia (Area Sampling Frame & crop-cutting surveys)
reports.description: Official harvested-area and production statistics for paddy (GKG) and rice. Java (especially East, West and Central) dominates production; the series is central to food-security and inflation analysis.
reports._notes: Foundational food-security production node. Strong Java concentration.
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Luas Panen dan Produksi Padi di Indonesia' appears once a year, each around 1 August: 2022 ed. 03 Aug 2023, 2023 ed. 01 Aug 2024, 2024 ed. 01 Aug 2025. (BPS additionally issues KSA-based monthly production press releases, e.g. Juli 2025 released 01 Sep 2025.)

reports.title: Sea Transportation Statistics
reports.description: Annual statistics on ship calls, cargo loading/unloading, and passenger embarkation/disembarkation for domestic and international voyages at Indonesian seaports. Direct empirical counterpart to the inter-island and chokepoint layers.
reports._notes: Operational maritime-transport node that quantifies the domestic and international shipping activity through Indonesian ports.

reports.title: Domestic multimodal transport statistics (sea, air, rail, river/ferry)
reports.description: High-frequency and annual statistics on passenger and goods movement by sea, air, rail and river/lake/ferry modes. Captures the multi-modal character of mobility across the archipelago.
reports._notes: Broader mobility densification around the sea-transport core.
reports._cadence_evidence: BPS press release 'Perkembangan Pariwisata dan Transportasi Nasional' is issued monthly (editions for Oktober 2009, November 2012, Februari 2015, Agustus 2021, Januari/Maret/April 2023). The annual compendia (Statistik Transportasi Laut etc.) are separate 'Tahunan' books.

reports.title: Women and Men in Indonesia
reports.description: Annual gender-statistics compendium covering population, employment, health, education, housing, ICT and household socio-economic status for women and men.
reports._notes: Core gender-statistical product.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index of 38 Provinces
reports.description: Provincial CPI series (current base 2022=100) that reveal price-level and inflation differentials across the archipelago. Complements the national CPI and feeds analysis of inter-island price disparities.
reports._notes: Spatial price node that makes archipelagic price diversity statistically visible.
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Indeks Harga Konsumen 38 Provinsi di Indonesia 2025 (2022=100)' page states Periodisasi 'Tahunan', released 09 Apr 2026 (2024 edition 10 Apr 2025); it compiles the monthly consumer price surveys.

reports.title: Electricity generation by source / power-plant type
reports.publisher: BPS / Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources related
reports.description: Statistics on electricity production by generation type. Coal-fired (PLTU) remains dominant; gas, hydro, geothermal and other sources make up the balance. Total generation has been rising with demand.
reports._notes: Core power-mix node. Coal dominance is a central structural feature of the Indonesian energy system.
reports._url_evidence: BPS page confirms 'Statistik Listrik 2020-2024' from the Annual Survey of Electricity Companies: installed capacity, electricity produced and distributed.
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Statistik Listrik 2020-2024' publication page states Periodisasi 'Tahunan', released 31 Dec 2025 (catalogue 6205005), described as a continuation of previous editions.

reports.title: Energy Balance of Indonesia (detailed production–consumption)
reports.description: Official energy balance covering production through final consumption for oil, gas, coal and renewables. Extends the earlier Energy Balances node with fuller multi-year detail.
reports._notes: Comprehensive energy-flow node.
_referenced_by: Coal, oil and gas production series

reports.title: Crude oil and condensate production statistics
reports.publisher: BPS / Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources
reports.description: Long-run series of petroleum and condensate production. Shows the long-term decline from earlier peak levels; Indonesia is no longer a net oil exporter in the classic sense.
reports._notes: Declining-oil production node — important contrast with the still-large coal and gas roles.
reports._cadence_evidence: Ditjen Migas ESDM issues 'Buku Statistik Minyak dan Gas Bumi' twice a year - a Semester I edition (Semester I 2023, Semester I 2024) plus a full-year book (Statistik Migas 2022) on migas.esdm.go.id.

reports.title: Natural gas production statistics
reports.publisher: BPS / Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources
reports.description: Natural gas production series (MMscf). Gas remains a significant domestic and export energy commodity and feeds both power generation and industrial use / LNG.
reports._notes: Gas-side counterpart to the oil and coal nodes.
reports._cadence_evidence: Same series as oil: Ditjen Migas 'Buku Statistik Minyak dan Gas Bumi' with a Semester I edition (2023, 2024) plus an annual book (2022) - two issues per year.

reports.title: Religious composition statistics (Islam, Christianity, Hinduism, Buddhism, etc.)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Home Affairs (Dukcapil) / Population Census / BPS-related
reports.description: Official population statistics by religion. Islam constitutes the large majority (~87 %); Protestant, Catholic, Hindu, Buddhist, Confucian and other recognised categories make up the remainder. Continuously cited in social, cultural and political analysis.
reports._notes: Foundational social-identity node. Indonesia is the world’s largest Muslim-majority country; the official multi-religion statistics also capture significant Christian, Hindu and other communities.
_referenced_by: Regional cultural and political analysis (e.g. Bali Hindu concentration)
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved the BPS census portal table 'Penduduk Menurut Wilayah dan Agama yang Dianut, di INDONESIA' (Population by Region and Religion), Sensus Penduduk 2010, with figures rendering: Islam 104,528,568 (of a 237,641,326 total shown for the displayed breakdown), Kristen 7,118,678, Katolik 9,409,835, Hindu 2,418,492, Buddha 4,489,381, Khonghucu 117,091, Lainnya 139,582, plus urban/rural and sex disaggregation. Dukcapil publishes no religion-composition product; this BPS census table is the official statistical source.
reports._url_route: BPS subdomain sensus.bps.go.id (census tabular topic pages), found by searching the exact Indonesian table name
reports._cadence_evidence: The cited page is the SP2010 tabular topic 'Penduduk Menurut Wilayah dan Agama yang Dianut'; the census religion tables exist for SP2010 and SP2020, ten years apart. Page metadata states only 'Frekuensi update: Lebih dari Dua Tahunan'.

reports.title: Geothermal power and renewable generation statistics
reports.publisher: BPS / Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources related
reports.description: Statistics on geothermal (PLTP) and other renewable generation. Indonesia has one of the world’s largest geothermal resource bases; actual generation remains a smaller but stable share of the mix.
reports._notes: Renewable-side densification of the energy cluster; geothermal is a distinctive Indonesian asset.
_referenced_by: Energy Balances and NDC / energy-transition documents
reports._url_evidence: MEMR page confirmed as the Handbook of Energy & Economic Statistics of Indonesia (HEESI) series, listing editions 2010-2025 covering energy supply including geothermal and renewables.
reports._cadence_evidence: ESDM's 'Handbook of Energy and Economic Statistics of Indonesia' page lists one edition per year: 2010, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025.

reports.title: Tanjung Priok Port operational statistics
reports.description: Operational statistics for Indonesia’s principal container and logistics gateway port — vessel calls, container throughput (recently ~8.3 million TEUs), non-container cargo and related indicators. Central node in the national and international shipping system.
reports._notes: Primary international-gateway port node.
_referenced_by: Foreign trade and inter-island trade nodes
reports._url_evidence: BPS DKI Jakarta page confirms 'Statistik Transportasi Provinsi DKI Jakarta 2025' covering land, sea and air transport; the series is BPS's carrier for Tanjung Priok cargo and passenger data (port not named in the abstract itself).
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Statistik Transportasi Provinsi DKI Jakarta 2025' page states Periodisasi 'Tahunan', released 26 May 2026.

reports.title: Tanjung Perak Port operational statistics
reports.description: Operational statistics for Tanjung Perak — major passenger and domestic-cargo hub in East Java. Frequently ranks among the busiest ports for inter-island passenger and cargo volumes.
reports._notes: Primary eastern-Java / domestic inter-island port node.
_referenced_by: Inter-island trade and East Java provincial nodes
reports._url_evidence: BPS East Java page confirms 'Statistik Transportasi Provinsi Jawa Timur 2023' presenting land, sea and air transport statistics for the province containing Tanjung Perak (port not named in the abstract itself).
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Statistik Transportasi Provinsi Jawa Timur 2023' page states Periodisasi 'Tahunan', released 24 Sep 2024.

reports.title: Major Indonesian ports system (Belawan, Makassar, and others)
reports.publisher: Pelindo / BPS / Ministry of Transportation related
reports.description: System-level view of the main commercial ports that handle the bulk of international and inter-island cargo and passengers. Complements the detailed Priok and Perak nodes and links to the chokepoint and connectivity layers.
reports._notes: Umbrella ports-system node.
_referenced_by: Tanjung Priok and Tanjung Perak nodes
reports._url_evidence: BPS page confirms 'Statistik Transportasi Laut 2024': vessel calls, cargo loading/unloading and passenger movements at seaports across 36 provinces.
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Statistik Transportasi Laut 2024' page states Periodisasi 'Tahunan', released 01 Dec 2025 (catalogue 8304003), covering sea ports in 36 provinces.

reports.title: Profile of Ethnic Groups (Long Form Population Census 2020)
reports.description: Official socio-demographic profiles of major ethnic groups drawn from the Long Form SP2020 — age/sex composition, island distribution, concentration, fertility, marriage age, life expectancy, migration, education, and languages spoken. Captures the extreme ethnic diversity of the archipelago.
reports._notes: Foundational ethnic-diversity node. Complements the religious-composition series.
_referenced_by: Population Census and Long Form results
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Profil Suku dan Keragaman Bahasa Daerah Hasil Long Form Sensus Penduduk 2020' was released 12 Dec 2024 - a product of the Long Form of the decennial census (SP2010 -> SP2020), so roughly one round per ten years.

reports.title: Regional language diversity statistics (Long Form SP2020)
reports.description: Statistics on the use of regional languages within families and communities, and the diversity of local languages by island. Documents the linguistic plurality that sits alongside Indonesian as the national language.
reports._notes: Linguistic-diversity counterpart to the ethnic and religious nodes.
reports._cadence_evidence: Same publication: 'Profil Suku dan Keragaman Bahasa Daerah Hasil Long Form Sensus Penduduk 2020' (12 Dec 2024), tied to the decennial census Long Form.

reports.title: Crime Statistics (Statistik Kriminal)
reports.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia (Police registration + Susenas + Podes)
reports.description: Annual crime statistics combining police administrative records (crime total, crime rate, crime clock), Susenas victimisation data, and Village Potential (Podes) indicators of local crime incidence. Reporting rates to police remain relatively low.
reports._notes: Core security and justice statistical product.

reports.title: Crime victimisation and reporting-rate statistics
reports.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia (Susenas component of Crime Statistics)
reports.description: Survey-based measures of the share of the population that experiences crime and the rate at which incidents are reported to the police. Complements the administrative crime-count series.
reports._notes: Victim-side densification of the security cluster.
reports._url_evidence: BPS page confirms 'Statistik Kriminal 2024/2025' and cites Susenas-based victimisation (0.73%) and crime reporting rate (20.28%) for 2024.
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Statistik Kriminal 2024/2025' publication page states frequency 'Tahunan' (annual), released 12 Dec 2025, catalogue 4401002, ISSN 2089-5291.

reports.title: BNPB – National Disaster Management Authority
reports.description: National focal point for disaster management, directly under the President. Coordinates risk reduction, preparedness, response and recovery. Publishes the integrated disaster data portal and the Indonesian Disaster Risk Index.
reports._notes: Institutional core of the disaster-management system.
_referenced_by: All disaster occurrence, risk-index and subnational BPBD series
reports._cadence_evidence: data.bnpb.go.id is the Portal Satu Data Bencana - an event-level disaster data portal with pre/during/post-disaster dashboards and incident-specific pages; discrete outputs are annual compilations, but the underlying database accumulates events continuously.

reports.title: Disaster occurrence and impact statistics (by type and year)
reports.description: Compiled statistics on the number and impact of disasters by type (floods, landslides, earthquakes, tsunamis, volcanic eruptions, drought, extreme weather, coastal erosion, forest/peat fires, etc.) over multi-year periods.
reports._notes: Core empirical series for Indonesia’s high multi-hazard exposure.
reports._cadence_evidence: The BNPB portal lists one 'Kompilasi Data Kejadian dan Dampak Bencana' per year - the 2024 compilation and the 2025 compilation dated 01 Jul 2026.

reports.title: Indonesian Disaster Risk Index (IRBI)
reports.description: Composite index assessing disaster risk at provincial and district/city levels across major hazards. Used to prioritise Special Allocation Funds for disaster management and to guide local risk-reduction strategies.
reports._notes: Key spatial risk node that makes inter-regional differences in hazard exposure statistically explicit.
reports._url_evidence: BNPB product page confirms IRBI as the annual disaster risk index at district/city and provincial level (bnpb.go.id itself returns 403 to WebFetch).
reports._cadence_evidence: The IRBI product page on direktoripb.bnpb.go.id states the index is 'dikeluarkan setiap tahun' (issued annually); initiation year 2014, implementation 2015.

reports.title: Volcanic and earthquake / tsunami hazard and event statistics
reports.region: Especially Ring of Fire zones (Java, Sumatra, Sulawesi, eastern islands)
reports.description: Statistics and monitoring products focused on volcanic eruptions, earthquakes and tsunamis — the high-impact geophysical hazards that define much of Indonesia’s risk profile and have driven major policy redesigns (e.g. post-Palu tsunami warning improvements).
reports._notes: Geophysical-hazard densification. Indonesia sits on the Pacific Ring of Fire.
reports._url_evidence: Confirmed as PVMBG (Center for Volcanology and Geological Hazard Mitigation, Badan Geologi ESDM), publishing daily volcano status/alert levels, seismic counts and eruption observations.
reports._cadence_evidence: vsi.esdm.go.id is a live monitoring portal: near-daily 'Laporan Kebencanaan Geologi' entries and a continuously maintained list of volcano alert levels (Level II/III statuses with dates), not a discrete release series.

reports.title: Indonesia–Japan Economic Partnership Agreement (IJEPA)
reports.description: Indonesia’s first bilateral EPA. Covers goods, services, investment and capacity building. Continuously cited in Japan–Indonesia trade and investment analysis.
reports._notes: Foundational bilateral EPA node with Japan.
_referenced_by: Foreign trade and FDI statistics (Japan partner share)
reports._url_evidence: Ministry of Trade DG for International Trade Negotiations page describes IJEPA: signed 2007, in force 1 July 2008, scope and general review.

reports.title: ASEAN–Australia–New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (AANZFTA)
reports.description: Multilateral FTA between ASEAN and Australia/New Zealand covering goods, services and investment. Part of the broader ASEAN+ network.
reports._notes: ASEAN+ Oceania trade-architecture node.
reports._url_evidence: Official AANZFTA site overview page lists the twelve parties including Indonesia and the agreement's goods/services/investment coverage.

reports.title: Indonesia–Australia Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (IA-CEPA)
reports.description: Bilateral comprehensive partnership covering goods, services, investment and temporary movement of persons.
reports._notes: Bilateral Australia CEPA node.
_referenced_by: Trade and FDI statistics with Australia
reports._url_evidence: Australian DFAT in-force agreements page for IA-CEPA, describing the bilateral framework, trade figures and the skills-exchange pilot.

reports.title: Indonesia–EU Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (IEU-CEPA)
reports.description: Comprehensive trade agreement covering the large majority of tariff lines. Negotiations concluded; entry into force pending ratification (targeted around 2027 in recent reporting).
reports._notes: Major prospective European trade-architecture node.
reports._url_evidence: European Commission DG Trade page confirms the EU-Indonesia CEPA: negotiations launched 2016, concluded 23 September 2025, plus the Investment Protection Agreement.

reports.title: Bilateral Investment Treaty (BIT) network
reports.publisher: Government of Indonesia / UNCTAD navigator compilations
reports.description: Indonesia’s stock of bilateral investment treaties (in force, signed, terminated). Provides the legal infrastructure for investment protection and is continuously referenced in FDI and investor-state analysis.
reports._notes: Umbrella investment-treaty network node.
reports._url_evidence: UNCTAD Investment Policy Hub country page lists Indonesia's BITs by status: 28 in force, 13 signed, 31 terminated.
reports._cadence_evidence: UNCTAD's IIA Navigator country page for Indonesia is a treaty database (73 BITs plus 25 TIPs and 25 further frameworks listed), updated as treaty statuses change; the page states no release schedule.

reports.title: Overall FTA / CEPA network overview
reports.description: System-level view of Indonesia’s active and prospective free-trade and comprehensive economic partnership agreements (ASEAN, RCEP, bilaterals with Japan, Australia, EU, etc.). Organises the individual treaty nodes.
reports._notes: High-level trade-architecture organising node.
_referenced_by: All individual FTA/CEPA and BIT nodes
reports._url_evidence: Ministry of Trade DG PPI publications page lists the 'Indonesia Trade Negotiations Agenda (as of July 2026)' plus factsheets for IEU-CEPA, ICA-CEPA, I-EAEU FTA etc., i.e. the system-level FTA/CEPA overview.
reports._cadence_evidence: ditjenppi.kemendag.go.id/publikasi shows no frequency statement and no regular series: 'Indonesia Trade Negotiations Agenda (as of July 2026)' posted 22 Jul 2026 and five CEPA/PTA factsheets all posted 27 Jan 2026.

reports.title: Indonesia Democracy Index (IDI)
reports.description: Official composite democracy index published by BPS at national, central and provincial levels (new method). Provides a statistical measure of democratic performance and its spatial variation across the 38 provinces.
reports._notes: Core official democracy-measurement node.
_referenced_by: International democracy assessments that cite official data

reports.title: National Strategy for Corruption Prevention (Stranas PK) and integrity framework
reports.description: Strategic anti-corruption and public-integrity framework (Stranas PK and successor instruments). Centres the formal regulatory architecture for conflict-of-interest, asset declaration, political finance and related integrity rules.
reports._notes: Central anti-corruption policy-frame node.
reports._url_evidence: Official KPK page setting out the Stranas PK 2025-2026 action plan (15 actions across licensing/trade, state finances, law enforcement and bureaucratic reform); the dedicated stranaspk.kpk.go.id host does not resolve for WebFetch.
reports._cadence_evidence: The cited KPK news item (09 Dec 2024) announces the launch of 15 Stranas PK corruption-prevention actions for the 2025-2026 period, described as an extension of previous action sets - i.e. one action-plan cycle every two years.

reports.title: Asset-declaration and conflict-of-interest regulatory regime
reports.description: Rules requiring asset declarations by elected officials, judges and civil servants, and related conflict-of-interest provisions. Part of the formal integrity architecture.
reports._notes: Specific integrity-instrument node.
reports._url_evidence: KPK service page describes the LHKPN asset-declaration obligation, who must report, annual filing and sanctions under Law 28/1999.
reports._cadence_evidence: The KPK LHKPN page states 'Setiap tahunnya, penyelenggara negara baik dari Yudikatif, Legislatif, Eksekutif, dan BUMN/D diwajibkan membuat LHKPN' - an annual declaration cycle. The page is a service/regulatory page rather than a dated publication.

reports.title: District/City Government Finance Statistics (Statistik Keuangan Pemerintah Kabupaten/Kota)
reports.description: Annual statistics on the revenues and expenditures of district and city governments across Indonesia. Captures the fiscal capacity and spending patterns of the lowest significant tier of subnational government.
reports._notes: Core subnational fiscal node at kabupaten/kota level.

reports.title: Fiscal equalisation transfers (DAU, DAK, DBH)
reports.description: The main intergovernmental transfer instruments: Dana Alokasi Umum (general equalisation), Dana Alokasi Khusus (special purpose, including disaster), and Dana Bagi Hasil (revenue sharing). Central to understanding how resources are redistributed across a highly unequal archipelago.
reports._notes: Equalisation-mechanism node. Critical for spatial fiscal equity.
reports._url_evidence: Directorate General of Fiscal Balance data page shows allocation and realisation of Transfer ke Daerah broken into DBH, DAU and DAK with rupiah figures.
reports._cadence_evidence: The DJPK TKDD portal presents DBH/DAU/DAK/Otsus/Dana Desa by fiscal year with a year selector spanning 2011-2027 (one allocation dataset per year); realisation figures carry a 'per tanggal 18 Agustus 2026' tracking timestamp.

reports.title: Subnational own-source revenue (PAD) statistics and capacity
reports.description: Statistics and analysis of Pendapatan Asli Daerah (own-source revenue). Most districts remain heavily transfer-dependent; PAD capacity varies sharply and interacts with the DAU formula.
reports._notes: Own-source counterpart to the transfer system.
_referenced_by: Local government finance and DAU/DAK nodes
reports._url_evidence: BPS page confirms 'Statistik Keuangan Pemerintah Kabupaten/Kota 2024 dan 2025' on district/city revenue and expenditure realisation and optimising regional revenue.
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Statistik Keuangan Pemerintah Kabupaten/Kota 2024 dan 2025' page states 'Frekuensi Terbit: Tahunan', released 31 Dec 2025.

reports.title: Water Supply Statistics
reports.description: Annual statistics from the Water Supply Company Survey covering clean-water production, distribution and related indicators. Provides the formal water-utility statistical base.
reports._notes: Core water-utility statistical product.

reports.title: Water resources and irrigation / agricultural water indicators
reports.publisher: BPS Agricultural Indicators / Ministry of Public Works & Housing related
reports.description: Statistical and indicator material on water resources relevant to agriculture and broader use, including irrigation-related series. Java’s high population and agricultural intensity make water stress a recurring spatial and policy theme.
reports._notes: Resource-side water node that links food security, environment and spatial concentration.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved the national BPS publication page 'Statistik Air Bersih 2020-2024' (catalogue 6206001, ISSN 0853-6449, released 31 December 2025), presenting results of the Survei Tahunan Perusahaan Air Bersih 2024 in statistical tables. This is the national edition, not a provincial one - the earlier pass saw only provincial 'Statistik Air Bersih' titles. Caveat: it covers piped/clean-water supply undertakings rather than irrigation specifically; no national BPS irrigation publication was found.
reports._url_route: BPS national publication catalogue via Indonesian-language title search on www.bps.go.id
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Statistik Air Bersih 2020-2024' page states Periodisasi 'Tahunan', released 31 Dec 2025.

reports.title: Monthly Production Index of Large and Medium Manufacturing
reports.description: Monthly production index for large and medium manufacturing establishments by KBLI/ISIC subsector (base year 2010=100). Principal high-frequency indicator of industrial activity.
reports._notes: Core industrial high-frequency node.

reports.title: Directory of Manufacturing Industry (Direktori Industri Manufaktur)
reports.description: Annual directory and frame of large and medium manufacturing establishments. Supports the statistical business register and sampling for industrial surveys.
reports._notes: Frame and structural node for the manufacturing statistical system.

reports.title: Indonesia Foreign Trade Statistics – Exports
reports.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia (source data from Customs)
reports.description: Annual and higher-frequency export statistics by commodity (HS), destination country, province of origin and ISIC. Primary official measure of merchandise exports.
reports._notes: Core external-trade node. Commodity composition (including resource exports) is central to Indonesia’s external profile.
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Indonesia Foreign Trade Statistics Exports 2024, Book I' page states publishing frequency 'Annually', released 07 Jul 2025 (2023 Book II released 05 Jul 2024).

reports.title: Indonesia Foreign Trade Statistics – Imports
reports.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia (source data from Customs)
reports.description: Annual and higher-frequency import statistics by commodity, country of origin and other classifications. Complements the export series for the full merchandise trade picture.
reports._notes: Import-side counterpart to the export statistics.
reports._cadence_evidence: Import counterpart of the same annual series: 'Statistik Perdagangan Luar Negeri Indonesia Impor 2024, Buku I' released 07 Jul 2025 and the 2023 Buku I released 05 Jul 2024 - one edition per reference year.

reports.title: Energy Balances of Indonesia
reports.description: Annual energy balance covering production, conversion and consumption of energy by type. Supports energy-policy assessment and links to both domestic industry and export commodities (coal, gas, etc.).
reports._notes: Key resource and industrial-energy node for a major energy producer and exporter.
_referenced_by: National accounts and industrial energy analysis

reports.title: Producer Price Index / Wholesale Price statistics
reports.description: Producer and wholesale price indices that complement the CPI and feed into national-accounts deflators and industrial cost analysis.
reports._notes: Price-side densification of the industrial and macro layer.
reports._cadence_evidence: BPS issues 'Perkembangan Indeks Harga Perdagangan Besar' press releases monthly (Januari 2024 released 01 Feb 2024; Agustus 2024 BRS; monthly IHPB tables such as 'IHPB Mei 2024'). The annual compendium 'Indeks Harga Perdagangan Besar Indonesia' is separate (2024 ed. 22 Apr 2025, 2025 ed. 22 Apr 2026).

reports.title: Agricultural statistics (production, food crops, estate crops)
reports.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia / Ministry of Agriculture related
reports.description: Recurring statistics on food-crop and estate-crop production (including palm oil, rubber, cocoa, etc.), livestock and related agricultural indicators. Central to both domestic food security and major export commodities.
reports._notes: Primary-sector node. Estate crops (especially palm oil) are a major uniqueness layer for later densification.
reports._cadence_evidence: Kementan's 'Statistik Pertanian' book appears once per year (2023 and 2024 editions on satudata.pertanian.go.id), and BPS's crop compendia are likewise annual (e.g. Luas Panen dan Produksi Padi, one edition each August).

reports.title: Health and vital statistics (beyond census)
reports.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia / Ministry of Health related
reports.description: Health-related statistics including morbidity, health-facility access, insurance coverage indicators and complementary vital-event data that sit alongside the census-based demographic parameters.
reports._notes: Health-side densification of the social cluster.
reports._cadence_evidence: Kemenkes 'Profil Kesehatan Indonesia' has one edition per year - 2018, 2023 and 2024 editions published on kemkes.go.id.

reports.title: Inequality statistics (Gini ratio and related)
reports.description: Official Gini coefficient and related inequality measures derived primarily from Susenas consumption data. Published at national and provincial level.
reports._notes: Distributional counterpart to the poverty node.
reports._cadence_evidence: BPS Gini-ratio press releases come twice a year, matching the March and September Susenas: 'Gini Ratio Maret 2025' (25 Jul 2025), 'Gini Ratio September 2025' (05 Feb 2026), 'Gini Ratio September 2024' (15 Jan 2025).

reports.title: Monetary aggregates and banking statistics (Bank Indonesia)
reports.description: Money-supply (M1, M2, etc.), credit, and related banking indicators published by the central bank. Core high-frequency monetary data.
reports._notes: High-frequency monetary densification of the Bank Indonesia cluster.
reports._cadence_evidence: Bank Indonesia's SEKI page states 'SEKI merupakan publikasi bulanan yang diterbitkan oleh Bank'; the page lists consecutive monthly editions from September 2025 to June 2026. BI's 'Perkembangan Uang Beredar' is likewise monthly.

reports.title: Financial Stability Review (Bank Indonesia)
reports.description: Periodic assessment of financial-system stability, risks and macroprudential conditions. Flagship stability publication of the central bank.
reports._notes: Stability-narrative counterpart to the monthly SSKI data.
reports._cadence_evidence: The Bank Indonesia page for Kajian Stabilitas Keuangan No. 46 (February 2026, posted 27 Feb 2026) lists frequency 'Semesteran'; earlier editions alternate March/February and September (No. 28 Maret 2017, No. 31 September 2018).

reports.title: Palm-oil production and estate-crop statistics
reports.publisher: BPS – Statistics Indonesia / Ministry of Agriculture related
reports.description: Statistics on crude palm oil (CPO) and palm-kernel production, area, and related estate-crop indicators. Indonesia is the world’s largest palm-oil producer; the commodity is central to exports, land use, rural employment and environmental debate.
reports._notes: Highest-visibility agricultural-commodity node. Major uniqueness layer for Indonesia.
_referenced_by: Rural employment and regional GDP in producing provinces
reports._cadence_evidence: BPS 'Statistik Kelapa Sawit Indonesia' has one edition per reference year, each released around 30 November: 2014, 2015, 2017, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023 editions.

reports.title: Nickel and downstream mineral statistics
reports.publisher: BPS / Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources related / trade statistics
reports.description: Production, export and downstream-processing indicators for nickel (ore, matte, battery-grade intermediates). Indonesia has become a dominant global supplier and is pursuing aggressive downstream industrialisation of the nickel value chain.
reports._notes: Strategic mineral node. Central to both export earnings and the government’s downstream industrial strategy.
_referenced_by: Provincial economic accounts in producing regions
reports._url_evidence: PDF on Badan Geologi (ESDM) domain confirmed as 'Neraca Sumber Daya dan Cadangan Mineral dan Batubara Indonesia 2025', with a dedicated section on nickel laterite resources and reserves.
reports._cadence_evidence: The cited PDF is Badan Geologi's 'Neraca Sumber Daya dan Cadangan Mineral dan Batubara Indonesia Tahun 2025' (data through Dec 2024), described as an annually published national resource balance.

reports.title: Coal production and export statistics
reports.publisher: BPS / Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources related
reports.description: Statistics on coal production, domestic use and exports. Coal remains a major export commodity and a dominant source of domestic power generation.
reports._notes: Major energy-commodity node linking the resource and energy clusters.
reports._url_evidence: BPS page confirms 'Mining Statistics of Non-Petroleum and Natural Gas 2019-2023' covering production volume and value plus domestic and export sales for non-oil-and-gas mining (coal being the dominant component).
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Mining Statistics of Non-Petroleum and Natural Gas 2019-2023' (Statistik Pertambangan Non Minyak dan Gas Bumi) page states publishing frequency 'Annually', released 20 Dec 2024.

reports.title: Mining and quarrying statistics (broader)
reports.description: Broader mining and quarrying production and value statistics that contextualise nickel, coal, tin, copper, gold and other minerals within the national accounts and industrial structure.
reports._notes: Umbrella resource-extraction node.
reports._cadence_evidence: Same series: BPS 'Statistik Pertambangan Non Minyak dan Gas Bumi 2019-2023', publishing frequency 'Annually', released 20 Dec 2024.

reports.title: Provincial GDP (PDRB – Produk Domestik Regional Bruto)
reports.description: Official provincial gross regional domestic product series by industrial origin and expenditure. Primary quantitative measure of the extreme economic concentration on Java versus the resource-rich outer islands.
reports._notes: Core spatial-economic node. Essential for the Java vs outer-islands contrast.
reports._cadence_evidence: BPS 'Produk Domestik Regional Bruto Provinsi-Provinsi di Indonesia Menurut Lapangan Usaha' appears once a year - the 2021-2025 edition was released 13 Apr 2026.

reports.title: DKI Jakarta – capital special region
reports.description: Capital special region. Highest provincial GDP per capita, dominant services and government functions, extreme population density, and the primary node of the national urban system.
reports._notes: Primary capital-region node.
reports._url_evidence: BPS DKI Jakarta page confirms 'Provinsi DKI Jakarta Dalam Angka 2025', the annual provincial yearbook covering geography, governance, demographics and the economy.
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Provinsi DKI Jakarta Dalam Angka 2025' page states Periodisasi 'Tahunan', released 28 Feb 2025.

reports.title: Internal migration and urbanisation statistics
reports.description: Lifetime and recent migration flows, rural–urban movement, and urbanisation rates derived from the Population Census and intercensal surveys. Documents the long-run redistribution of population (including movements out of Java and into resource and urban destinations).
reports._notes: Demographic-flow node that links the census to the spatial economic structure.
_referenced_by: Population Census and Long Form results
reports._cadence_evidence: Migration statistics are a decennial census Long Form product: the provincial 'Statistik Migrasi ... Hasil Long Form Sensus Penduduk 2020' volumes (Papua, Bengkulu, DKI Jakarta, Riau, NTB, NTT and others) were all released on 14 Jul 2023 from the SP2020 base.

reports.title: Welfare Indicators (Indikator Kesejahteraan Rakyat)
reports.description: Annual BPS publication presenting multi-dimensional welfare development over time and across provinces and urban/rural areas. Draws on Susenas, Sakernas, Podes, the Population Census and population projections.
reports._notes: High-level social-indicator compendium that sits above the individual poverty and Gini series.

reports.title: BPJS Kesehatan / Jaminan Kesehatan Nasional (JKN) coverage statistics
reports.description: Administrative and published statistics on membership and coverage of the national health-insurance scheme (JKN) administered by BPJS Kesehatan. Near-universal enrolment numbers are a major social-protection achievement and a continuously cited policy indicator.
reports._notes: Flagship social-protection coverage node.
reports._cadence_evidence: BPJS Kesehatan issues 'Laporan Pengelolaan Program dan Laporan Keuangan' once per year (2021 and 2023 reports hosted on web.bpjs-kesehatan.go.id); annual submission/endorsement is mandated by PMK 186/PMK.02/2020. The bpjs-kesehatan.go.id landing page itself returned no readable content.

reports.title: Social-protection programme statistics (PKH, food assistance, and related)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Social Affairs / BPS / related agencies
reports.description: Statistics and administrative data on major social-assistance programmes, including the conditional cash-transfer programme (PKH) and food-assistance schemes. Central to poverty-reduction strategy and fiscal social spending.
reports._notes: Programme-level densification of the social-protection cluster.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved the BPS national statistics table 'Jumlah Keluarga Penerima Manfaat (KPM) dan Anggaran Bantuan Sosial Pangan Menurut Provinsi, 2024' - beneficiary families and food social-assistance budget by province, published by BPS. kemensos.go.id remains unreachable for WebFetch (robots.txt fetch times out) and satudata.kemenkopukm-style Kemensos portals fail TLS, so the BPS table is the confirmed official product covering food assistance; a PKH-specific national table was not found on a retrievable host.
reports._url_route: BPS national statistics-table catalogue on www.bps.go.id, after Kemensos hosts stayed unreachable
reports._cadence_evidence: The cited BPS table 'Jumlah Keluarga Penerima Manfaat (KPM) dan Anggaran Bantuan Sosial Pangan Menurut Provinsi' is published one year at a time (the URL carries year=2024 and the title carries a single year); the page shows no explicit periodicity metadata.

reports.title: Islamic / Sharia finance statistics (banking, capital market, non-bank)
reports.publisher: OJK (Financial Services Authority) / Bank Indonesia / related
reports.description: Official statistics on the Islamic financial services industry — sharia banking assets and financing, Islamic capital-market instruments, takaful, and related segments. Indonesia ranks among the larger global Islamic-finance markets and publishes dedicated development reports.
reports._notes: Distinctive financial-system node reflecting Indonesia’s dual conventional/sharia architecture.
reports._cadence_evidence: OJK's 'Statistik Perbankan Syariah' is a monthly release - the page lists consecutive monthly editions from September 2024 to June 2025 and notes that from the July 2025 period the data moved to OJK's Portal Data.

reports.title: OJK – Financial Services Authority institutional and statistical role
reports.description: Integrated financial-services regulator. Publishes banking, capital-market, non-bank and Islamic-finance statistics and the Indonesian Islamic Finance Development Report, among other products.
reports._notes: Third institutional pillar of the financial system alongside Bank Indonesia and the Ministry of Finance.
reports._cadence_evidence: ojk.go.id/data-dan-statistik is a portal of many parallel series with different cadences (monthly PEPK statistics, quarterly Laporan Triwulan OJK, annual Laporan Tahunan, plus sector statistics) - no single release cadence for the node.

reports.title: ASEAN economic cooperation framework (Indonesia as member)
reports.publisher: ASEAN / Indonesian Ministry of Trade and related
reports.description: Indonesia’s membership and participation in the ASEAN economic community frameworks. Continuously cited in trade, investment and regional-integration policy.
reports._notes: Foundational regional-integration node.
_referenced_by: Trade and investment statistics with ASEAN partners
reports._cadence_evidence: asean.org returned only a JavaScript redirect notice ('Javascript is required'); no frequency statement or countable dated series could be read, and the node describes an organisational/cooperation framework rather than a dated publication.

reports.title: Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) — Indonesia participation
reports.publisher: ASEAN / RCEP parties / Indonesian Ministry of Trade
reports.description: Indonesia’s participation in RCEP (entered into force for Indonesia January 2023). World’s largest FTA by population and GDP share; continuously cited in trade-policy and supply-chain analysis.
reports._notes: Major plurilateral trade-architecture node.
reports._url_evidence: ASEAN Secretariat RCEP page names the participating parties including Indonesia and describes the agreement's origin and coverage (it does not state entry-into-force dates).

reports.title: Population projections (Indonesia 2020–2050 and related)
reports.description: Official population projections based on the 2020 census parameters. Used throughout planning (RPJMN) and as the denominator for many per-capita and coverage indicators.
reports._notes: Forward-looking demographic node.
reports._cadence_evidence: The current projection set is 'Proyeksi Penduduk Indonesia 2020-2050 Hasil Sensus Penduduk 2020', with matching provincial/city projections derived from the same SP2020 base - one projection round per decennial census; no interval is stated on the page.

reports.title: Village Potential Statistics (Podes)
reports.description: Periodic census-style data collection on village-level infrastructure, facilities and potential. Unique granular source that feeds many rural-development and welfare analyses.
reports._notes: Distinctively granular rural/village node.
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Statistik Potensi Desa Indonesia 2025' page states Periodisasi 'Tahunan', released 11 Dec 2025 (2024 edition released 10 Dec 2024); the 2025 edition draws on the annual 'Pemutakhiran Data Perkembangan Desa'.

reports.title: National Medium-Term Development Plan (RPJMN) — statistical targets and monitoring
reports.description: The successive RPJMN documents set quantitative targets (poverty, inequality, human development, etc.) that are monitored primarily with BPS statistics. Functions as a high-level recurring-citation policy frame that organises much of the official statistical demand.
reports._notes: Central planning-frame node that many social and economic series are designed to serve.
_referenced_by: Poverty, Gini, education, health and welfare statistics
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved the Bappenas-hosted official copy of Peraturan Presiden No. 12 Tahun 2025 on the RPJMN 2025-2029. Content verified: defines the RPJMN as the five-year national development planning document for 2025-2029; specifies its four components (narrative, development matrix, ministry/agency matrix, regional development direction); requires Renstra-KL and regional plans to align with it; and mandates mid-term and end-of-period evaluation reported to the President, with indicative targets and funding adjusted annually. rpjmn.bappenas.go.id still does not resolve (DNS), jdih.bappenas.go.id and peraturan.bpk.go.id return 403, and the larger RPJMN narrative/summary PDFs exceed the fetch size limit.
reports._url_route: Bappenas e-library static file path (perpustakaan.bappenas.go.id), reached via the Bappenas publication listing rather than the dead rpjmn subdomain
reports._cadence_evidence: The cited document is Peraturan Presiden Republik Indonesia Nomor 12 Tahun 2025 tentang Rencana Pembangunan Jangka Menengah Nasional Tahun 2025-2029, dated 10 Feb 2025 - a presidential regulation, not a recurring statistical release.

reports.title: Forest cover and land-cover statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Forestry / BPS related / official monitoring
reports.description: Official monitoring of forested land area (recent figures around 95.5 million ha / ~51 % of land area). Primary quantitative measure of remaining forest stock inside and outside formal forest areas.
reports._notes: Stock-side environmental node that pairs with the flow (deforestation) series.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved the Ministry of Forestry statistics portal publication page 'State of Indonesia's Forest (SOIFO) 2024'; the abstract confirms it presents data, analysis and strategic indicators on forest-resource dynamics and land-cover change (tutupan hutan, perubahan tutupan lahan) for 2024, with the full PDF linked. statistik.kehutanan.go.id does resolve and render - contrary to the earlier finding - while menlhk.go.id's certificate is still expired.
reports._url_route: working alternate hostname statistik.kehutanan.go.id ('Forestix'), found by Indonesian-language search for the ministry's statistics publications
reports._cadence_evidence: statistik.kehutanan.go.id lists State of Indonesia's Forest (SOIFO) editions for 2020, 2022 and 2024 - one edition every two years.

reports.title: Deforestation rate statistics (gross and net)
reports.publisher: Ministry of Forestry / BPS (historical tables) / official satellite monitoring
reports.description: Annual gross and net deforestation figures (e.g. net ~175 thousand ha in recent monitoring). Broken down by forest type and inside/outside forest area. Continuously cited in environmental, commodity and climate policy.
reports._notes: High-visibility environmental flow node. Direct edge into the palm-oil and land-use clusters.
reports._cadence_evidence: Deforestation figures are carried in the ministry's annual forestry statistics books, listed on statistik.kehutanan.go.id for 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2024; the portal notes deforestation data are integrated into the annual compilations rather than published separately.

reports.title: Greenhouse-gas inventory and physical supply-use for emissions
reports.publisher: Ministry of Environment / BPS (physical supply-use tables) / related
reports.description: National GHG inventory and BPS physical supply-and-use tables for emissions by sector (energy, industry, agriculture, LULUCF, waste, etc.). Underpins NDC accounting and climate-policy analysis.
reports._notes: Core climate-statistical node. Large LULUCF and energy shares are distinctive for Indonesia.
_referenced_by: NDC and long-term climate strategy documents
reports._cadence_evidence: No page with a stated cadence for the national GHG inventory was readable: kemenlh.go.id items describe the SIGN-SMART reporting system and training rather than a dated publication series, and no countable inventory editions were listed.

reports.title: Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) and climate-policy framework
reports.publisher: Government of Indonesia / Ministry of Environment
reports.description: Indonesia’s successive NDCs and related long-term climate strategies. Recurring citation frame that organises emissions targets, LULUCF commitments and energy-transition language.
reports._notes: Policy-frame node for the climate cluster.
reports._url_evidence: UNFCCC NDC Registry confirmed to hold the 'Republic Of Indonesia Second NDC', submitted 27 October 2025, with active status.
reports._cadence_evidence: The UNFCCC NDC Registry records Indonesia's 'Republic of Indonesia Second NDC', submitted 27 Oct 2025; under Article 4 of the Paris Agreement Parties communicate a new NDC every five years (the registry page itself states only that NDCs 'shall be recorded in a public registry').

reports.title: E-Commerce Statistics
reports.description: Annual BPS survey-based publication on e-commerce businesses: profiles, workers, activities and transaction values, with provincial estimates. Official statistical window on the digital commercial economy.
reports._notes: Key digital-economy statistical product from BPS.

reports.title: Digital-economy and ICT indicators (broader)
reports.description: Broader official indicators of internet access, digital adoption, ICT sector contribution and related metrics that contextualise the e-commerce statistics within the wider digital transformation agenda.
reports._notes: Umbrella digital node surrounding the e-commerce survey.
reports._url_evidence: BPS page confirms 'Statistik Telekomunikasi Indonesia 2024': 72.78% internet use, device ownership, ICT trade and the ICT sector's 4.34% GDP share.
reports._cadence_evidence: 'Statistik Telekomunikasi Indonesia 2024' page states Periodisasi 'Tahunan', released 29 Aug 2025.

reports.title: Land-use and land-cover change statistics linked to agriculture and estates
reports.publisher: BPS / Ministry of Forestry / Ministry of Agriculture related
reports.description: Statistics and monitoring products that track conversion of forest and other land into agricultural and estate-crop uses (especially palm oil). Forms the land-use bridge between commodity expansion and deforestation/GHG outcomes.
reports._notes: Explicit land-use edge connecting the commodity and environmental clusters.
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved the BPS national statistics table, whose live title is 'Land Cover Area in Indonesia, Inside and Outside Forest Area by Class, 2014-2023 (thousand ha)' (the slug still says 2014-2021). Source BPS-Statistics Indonesia, compiled from Ministry of Environment and Forestry land-cover monitoring; it splits land-cover classes inside versus outside the designated forest estate, which is the series that tracks conversion of forest to agricultural and estate-crop cover.
reports._url_route: BPS national statistics-table catalogue on www.bps.go.id

A BPS national companion table 'Luas Kegiatan Reboisasi (Hektar)' also exists and loads at https://www.bps.go.id/id/statistics-table/2/ODQjMg==/luas-kegiatan-reboisasi--hektar-.html, but its page did not expose coverage years, so the ministry publication is returned.

reports.description: Official list and geographic statistics of Indonesia’s provinces (currently 38 after Papua splits), including land area and number of islands by province. Foundational spatial-frame node for all provincial series.

reports.description: Annual BPS publication on domestic tourism: visitor profiles, trip purpose, accommodation, duration and expenditure. Increasingly uses mobile-positioning and digital-survey methods.

reports.description: Statistics on tourism objects and attractions, their distribution, types (nature, cultural, man-made) and related revenue indicators. Highlights strong concentration in Java and Bali versus limited development in eastern regions.

reports.description: Official realization figures for foreign investment by country of origin, sector and (where published) location. Key capital-flow series complementary to the BOP financial account.

reports.description: Official Sakernas-based statistics on the share of informal employment. National figure remains high (around 58 % in recent data); provincial variation is large, with eastern and rural provinces showing much higher informality.

reports.description: Official or derived labour-productivity measures that link employment (Sakernas) to output (national accounts). Useful for dual-structure and formal/informal analysis.

reports.title: Statistics of Marine and Coastal Resources
reports.description: Annual BPS publication on the potential and management of marine and coastal resources. Framed around blue-economy, climate adaptation and sustainable coastal prosperity themes aligned with long-term national planning.
reports._notes: Core maritime-resource statistical product for the world’s largest archipelagic state.

reports.publisher: BPS / Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries related

url_research_pass.method: Per-country web research. A URL was accepted only when the page was actually retrieved and its content confirmed the publication. Publisher homepages, Wikipedia, news, aggregators and mirrors were rejected. Confirmations are stored on each node as _url_evidence.
